summary: L3Harris Technologies filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten offering of two series of senior unsecured notes with interest payable semi-annually, ranking equally with other unsecured, unsubordinated debt, and carrying a change-of-control repurchase covenant and optional redemption provisions. Principal amounts, coupons, maturities, and pricing are left blank in this preliminary filing, with joint book-running managers Citigroup, Scotiabank, US Bancorp, and Wells Fargo Securities named. This is a routine investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing, coupon, maturity, and use of proceeds.
